arguments.description: Realistic professional portrait photography of a Chinese marriage registration photo. Medium close-up, chest-up, classic ID-photo composition. A young East Asian couple standing side by side with shoulders level and close together: woman on the left, man on the right, both looking naturally into the camera with gentle, warm, natural smiles and soft natural eye contact. Woman has long dark hair worn down (not tied back), fair skin; man has a handsome styled short dark haircut. Both wear crisp plain white long-sleeve button-down shirts fully buttoned to the collar; each shirt collar has a small red heart decoration/embroidery near the collar. Solid deep crimson red official photo background with subtle texture. Soft even studio lighting, no harsh shadows, professional portrait look, photorealistic 8K quality, shot with Canon EF 50mm f/1.2L lens look, shallow natural depth of field, formal yet warm mood.
